claims.claim_text: The indexed Alfred Cahnmann is confirmed as the exact person recorded entering the United States Army as a private on December 3, 1942.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The OSS index and official Army merged record agree on the exact uncommon name and private identifier.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private-identifier and exact-name agreement across two official NARA records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record dates entry on December 3, 1942; it does not establish the Army-to-OSS transfer date.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier remains private. No namesake biography, refugee history, or postwar occupation is attached.

claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to Army entry on December 3, 1942; it is not proven to be the immediate pre-OSS role.
claims.match_notes: Occupation is not employer. No establishment, employer, city, or precise branch of the broad occupational group is identified.

claims.claim_text: The indexed 1st Lt. Rollie W. Cain is a high-confidence match to the officer identified on an OSS mission in China in 1945.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: An official CIA historical article identifies the exact uncommon full name and matching rank among Americans photographed with an OSS operational group in China in July 1945.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the exact uncommon full name, middle initial, matching first-lieutenant rank, explicit OSS context, and wartime date; the article does not reproduce the index identifier.
claims.temporal_assessment: The source establishes OSS service in China by July 1945 but provides no pre-OSS employer or predecessor chronology for Cain.
claims.match_notes: Box 100 remains necessary to confirm the private identifier and establish Cain's pre-OSS Army unit, civilian occupation, or employer.
